name: web-send
description: Send a message to the principal's phone app. recipient must be "principal". If a browser has the thread open, no notification is sent. If no phone is subscribed, this fails and does not send another way. If a subscription is dead, push setup is rejected, or the push service does not accept the message, this sends on the next configured channel and tells you which one, so you do not send it again.

inputs.context_bridge: string? (JSON, as signal-send's context_bridge: {agent_id, expected_reply?, delegation_hint?, metadata?, expires_in_hours?}. Used only when another channel sends)

outputs.channel: string (web, or the channel used when the phone could not be reached)
outputs.delivered_to: string? (the address the fallback channel used)
outputs.deferred_to_digest: boolean? (true when the relay budget held this message for the principal's digest instead of sending it)
outputs.note: string? (on another channel: standing preferences were not applied to the fallback order. With deferred_to_digest: the message is queued, so do not re-send it another way. Both when both apply)
